test_name: Search for Test Plans and Verify Results
description: This scenario tests the 'Search for Test Plans' functionality to ensure that valid and edge case inputs return the correct results or appropriate error messages.
steps: 1. Navigate to https://dev.roost.ai/roostgpt/tests.
2. Verify the visibility of the search input box labeled 'Search for Test Plans'.
3. Type a valid test plan name into the search box.
4. Press the Enter key or trigger the search functionality.
5. Verify that the results in the test plans table match the search query.
6. Clear the search input and type a random string that does not match any test plan.
7. Press the Enter key or trigger the search functionality.
8. Verify that an appropriate 'No results found' message is displayed.
9. Clear the search input and enter SQL injection strings (e.g., ' OR 1=1 -- ).
10. Press the Enter key or trigger the search functionality.
11. Verify that the input is sanitized and no results or errors are displayed.
12. Clear the search input and enter special characters (e.g., '@#$%^&*').
13. Press the Enter key or trigger the search functionality.
14. Verify that the input is sanitized and no results or errors are displayed.
15. Reload the page and verify that the search query and results are reset.
16. Type a valid test plan name and verify the result count matches the database record.
17. Attempt to use the search input while the page is loading and verify no issues occur.
18. Test the search field with extremely long strings and verify the application handles this gracefully.
19. Use keyboard navigation (Tab/Shift+Tab) to focus on the search box and verify accessibility.
20. Verify visually that the search input remains responsive across different screen sizes.
expected_results: Results should correctly filter based on the search query for valid inputs.
An appropriate 'No results found' message is displayed for invalid queries.
SQL injection and special characters are sanitized to prevent security vulnerabilities.
No errors or crashes occur when using edge case inputs.
Search results reset after the page reloads.
edge_cases: Entering special characters as a query.
Using SQL injection strings as input.
Using the search while the page is still loading.
Typing a string with leading/trailing spaces.
dependencies: The test plans database must contain at least one valid test plan.
The search functionality must be implemented and functional.
The test plans table must be visible on the page.

expected_responses.body: List of test plans matching the query

performance_metrics: Search results should appear within 300ms of submitting a query.
The page should not freeze or lag when handling large inputs.
accessibility_requirements: WCAG 2.1: Ensure the search input is keyboard-navigable.
Ensure the label 'Search for Test Plans' is associated with the input field.
Check color contrast for the placeholder text.
